info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Kroehnki Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Kroehnki Notebook Detail Management API enables users to efficiently create and manage detailed entries for Kroehnki notebooks. This endpoint facilitates adding critical information such as specifications, features, and prices, ensuring that the catalog remains comprehensive and up-to-date. Businesses involved in inventory management, e-commerce, and product development can leverage this API to enhance their product offerings. It simplifies the process for developers aiming to integrate notebook detail creation within their applications.

post.summary: Create details for a Kroehnki notebook.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and submit detailed information for a Kroehnki notebook. Ensure that all required fields are filled out in the request body to successfully create the notebook details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide details for the operation on the Kroehnki notebook. It should contain all necessary information relevant to the request, formatted in JSON.

200.description: Request completed successfully; the details are returned.
